thread:
Marta L.: Hey team, excited to join! Monitor kit arrived but I'm missing the USB-C cable and the dock's firmware updater isn't recognized on my Mac — it throws permission errors when I try to run the helper from the USB stick. Ticket IT-4912. Any quick help?

Devon (IT): welcome Marta! For the permission errors: macOS Gatekeeper and notarization can block unknown binaries. Which macOS version? Also try: System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> Allow apps downloaded from: App Store and identified developers -> then allow the blocked helper under 'Security & Privacy' -> 'Allow Anyway'. If it's a zsh permission issue, `chmod +x /Volumes/IT-STICK/triton-fw-flash.sh` then run with `sudo`.

Marta L.: I'm on Ventura 13.6. Followed the steps but still gets "operation not permitted" when flashing. I'm remote (Lisbon) so can't bring it in. The stick also only shows a 2GB image even though the fw is 600MB — odd.

Priya S.: we had a similar issue where the stick was formatted exFAT and macOS mounted it read-only because of a corrupted partition table. Devon, could the shipping batch have older prepped sticks?

Devon (IT): Possible. I'll check the image and re-make a stick. For now, I can provide an alternate route: we can email a signed dmg of the helper tool and a plist to register as an installer and use the macOS installer flow. But that requires our package to be notarized by Apple which takes ~24h. Given you're remote and need to finish first-week setup, I'll send a new prepped stick from EU stock and a short USB-C cable.

it-bot: Ticket IT-4912 updated: "Reship EU prepped USB stick + USB-C cable; alternate signed DMG if needed."

Marta L.: Thanks Devon — EU kit would be great. One more odd thing: the monitor is showing a greenish tint at 2560x1440, but looks fine at 1080p. Any ideas?

Devon (IT): Could be DP MST/EDID negotiation mismatch. Try forcing color profile: System Settings -> Displays -> Color -> select sRGB IEC61966-2.1 or calibrate. Also try a different refresh rate (60 vs 75Hz) and swap cables when the kit arrives. If persists we'll swap the panel.

Priya S.: welcome Marta! For onboarding FYI, there's a Slack channel #new-hire-setup with quick checklists. Also ping me if you want pairing sessions.

Marta L.: Appreciate it all 60a Will update ticket once kit arrives and I test the flash and color profile.
